Exactly equivalent pure constant extraction for HIGH_WINDOW50. The only moved expressions are p,sp,b,s3 and h(w),s5(w), each independent ofn,a,m,d0,M and of mutable radius/K4/K5. Their original arithmetic order is preserved. Cache keys include the exact F constructor identity and window, with typed=True, so Fraction and named FLOAT evaluations remain separate. Original event/window gates execute before the cached expressions; no gate is removed. The remaining complete six-term formulas and best-window pool are byte-preserved. This is not a new analytic bound.
